ios.title: Add to Home Screen
ios.description: The iPhone has no install button. Follow these steps to add the app to your home screen.
ios.step1: Tap the Share button (a square with an arrow) in the Safari bar.
ios.step2: Scroll down and tap More (…) to show all actions.
ios.step4: Confirm with “Add”. The app then appears on your home screen.
